column4: Previously submitted and might change, but the concept is that Finn grew up in this city with a blue collar family. He worked selling newspapers as a newsie on a street corner as a child, but later became an opinion leader and announcer for radio broadcast in the town. He operates an independent news station and paper that works to investigate crime, announce on the city's going ons, and sharing whatever truths he finds or conjures up.

A humble Vedelken artificer who seeks to improve his life and others around him but in secret he searches for power within the confines of the law of course

Chalchi hails from the Ichtaca tribe, a formerly-isolated tribe based on Aztec civilisation which has recently decided to rejoin the world at large. She, as High Priestess of Quetzalcoatl, their patron god of knowledge, has become an emissary - to teach others of her culture, and to learn about the cultures of others, and atone for her people's bloody past.

She and her people are reskins of the Simic Hybrid race, with feathery wings instead of fins for the Manta Glide ability as well as some other traits of the feathered serpent.
